newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan gang leader jailed for 30 years.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan gang leader jailed for 30 years.

text.p: A Moroccan gang leader was sentenced to 30 years in jail for murder, rape, drug trafficking and forgery, the official MAP news agency said on Friday.
The man, who was identified as El Mokhtar Belamkaddem, ran a gang of 20 criminals including a police inspector, the agency said.
The inspector, named as Bouchaib Maskhoune, was sentenced to one year imprisonment, it added.
